span.p:
NO AUTOMATIC EXIT.
normalize-product, categorize-product, whatsapp-notify and
account-cleanup rows are not replayable at all — the replay
action rejects any queue other than extract-invoice
(admin/dead-letters/+page.server.ts:99). Their only exits are a
human status change or the 180-day purge.
No alert fires on growth: monitoring.md:70-71 names "above 0 / above
10 in 24 h" for scheduled-job failures, and nothing in the repo
wires a dead_letter_queue threshold to a pager.
